description: Create a TikTok Business Center for the user's business, on their OWN TikTok Ads connection and in THEIR company name, never Hermoso's. Use it when create_tiktok_ads_account reports the login has no Business Center it administers. TWO STEPS, ALWAYS: call it first WITHOUT confirm. That sends nothing and either lists what is missing or returns the exact Business Center and the TikTok terms the user would be agreeing to. Ask the user for every field and never guess one: bcName, companyName (their legal name), registeredArea, timezone (permanent) and currency. Show the user that reply word for word, and call again with confirm:true only after THEY have agreed. The reply is read back from TikTok. Then create the ad account inside it. Free.

bcName.description: a name for the Business Center; duplicates are refused

companyName.description: the legal name of the user's business

confirm.description: REQUIRED true to create, only after the user has agreed to the terms in the first reply

contactName.description: optional contact block: give all of it or none

contactPhoneRegion.description: two-letter region of the phone number

currency.description: three-letter currency, e.g. USD; ad accounts inside must use it

registeredArea.description: two-letter country of registration, e.g. US

secondaryIndustry.description: tier-2 industry id; needed with the contact block on SELF_SERVICE

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York; cannot be changed later

type.description: default SELF_SERVICE, the user's own business; SELF_SERVICE_AGENCY for an agency

name: create_tiktok_ads_business_center
title: Create a TikTok Business Center
